# Rohit Builds

> A portfolio of passion projects built by Rohit Bhandari — an AI-powered education system for every age, a curated AI news portal, and hands-on learning tools.

This file is a lightweight index for LLMs and AI agents. Full site content in llms-full.txt.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/): Rohit Builds — The new education system. AI-powered, personalized, and free for every age group. 5 age groups, 7 apps.
- [Portfolio](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/portfolio/): Careers page — Azure Data Engineer evolving into a platform-minded architect.
- [Courses](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/courses/): Education system courses — Bot Buddies (4-7), Code Kids (8-11), Code Quest (12-15), AI Lab (15-17), Career Launcher (18+).
- [News](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/news/): Curated AI news portal with dated editions.
- [Pomoflow](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/pomoflow/): Focus timer app.
- [Flashcard](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/flashcard/): Flashcard learning app.
- [Interview](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/interview/): AI interview prep app.
- [Jobtool](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/jobtool/): Job search helper tool.
- [Shop](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/shop/): Storefront project.
- [Applications](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/applications/): Age-group hubs (4-7, 8-11, 12-15, 15-17, 18+).
- [Contact](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/portfolio/#contact): Reach the builder.

## Notes

- Site name is "Rohit Builds"; older branding ("Education Reimagined", "RBPN") is retired.
- All projects are free and built by hand; mission is world-class education for everyone.
